newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-PSV STAY TOP WITH 2-0 DEFEAT OF AJAX.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PSV STAY TOP WITH 2-0 DEFEAT OF AJAX.

text.p: PSV Eindhoven stayed on top of the Dutch first division on Sunday by beating Ajax 2-0, the Amsterdammers' first league defeat since the winter break.

PSV proved more aggressive and creative than Ajax who, without injured striker Patrick Kluivert and suspended Jari Litmanen, seemed jaded after their midweek defeat by Juventus in their European Cup semifinal.
Philip Cocu gave PSV the lead after 15 minutes with a shot from 20 metres which curled away from goalkeeper Edwin van der Sar.
In the 54th minute newly-signed Belgian striker Gille de Bilde settled the match with his second goal in two games for PSV, firing in a cross from Boudewijn Zenden.

PSV's main rivals Feyenoord also won 2-0, making no mistake against lowly Willem II Tilburg. They stay level on points with PSV, 62 from 28 matches, but are second because of PSV's far superior goal difference.

It was a poor match and the goals, both scored by defenders, came late. In the 72nd minute Fernando Picun headed home the opener from a corner and, nine minutes from time, Henk Fraser evaded the offside trap to thump in a second.
Ajax are 14 points behind the leaders in fourth place. They have a game in hand but, with seven games to play, they only have a mathematical chance of retaining their title.
Third-placed Twente Enschede also lost touch with the leaders, missing out on three precious points in their 1-0 home defeat to Groningen.
